sources_inspected.label: Texas Natural Resources Code, Chapter 91 (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: Texas Natural Resources Code Chapter 91 supplies the current statutory source for the bounded payment-information and written-request context described from Sections 91.502, 91.504, 91.505, and 91.507.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the code only to identify source fields and preserve a dated request trail; it does not interpret the statute, a private instrument, deadlines, rights, remedies, payment correctness, or liability for an owner.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Production Data Query FAQs (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission explains the lease-level or gas-well-level reporting basis, online reporting lag, update cadence, and possibility of revised, corrected, or delinquent production reports.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article uses the FAQ only to preserve query criteria, identifiers, periods, retrieval dates, and public-record limits; it rejects turning regulator production into owner payment accounting, a deduction result, a decimal, or entitlement.

sources_inspected.label: Railroad Commission of Texas, Production Data Query (accessed 2026-08-23)
sources_inspected.source_location_or_paraphrase: The Railroad Commission Production Data Query is the current first-party query surface for reported Texas production by its available lease, gas-well, operator, field, district, county, and period criteria.
sources_inspected.claim_scope: The article retains the query only as identifier and period context and does not use it to verify a royalty statement amount, cost, realized price, owner decimal, lease meaning, or payment entitlement.
